method: Direct inspection of six timestamp-matched source/commanded/measured RGB thumbnails; unblinded qualitative assessment, not full-video review.
observations: Both arms retain the recognizable playground; no near-total collapse is visible in these samples.
Both arms show a contrast/saturation pulse at frame 85.
Later outputs alter the roof/rail appearance and introduce a dark upper-right region absent from the matched source reference.
Mean position worsens 28.06% and endpoint position worsens 6.55%; lower mean rotation does not reverse this translation failure.
classification: Position regression despite lower mean rotation; recognizable playground with appearance artifacts.
temporal_limitation: Static sampled thumbnails do not resolve physical camera reversal, exclude between-sample collapse, or quantify perceptual video quality.
